causal_claim: Perceptron made the modern AI agent possible by establishing the learnable weighted-neuron unit that all deep networks, and therefore every LLM behind an agent, are built from.
definition: Rosenblatt's perceptron was the first trainable artificial neural network, learning classification weights from examples on the Mark I Perceptron machine.
name: Perceptron
source_title: Perceptron - Wikipedia

causal_claim: Backpropagation made the modern AI agent possible by giving multi-layer networks an efficient training algorithm, without which transformer-scale models could not be fitted to data.
definition: The Rumelhart, Hinton and Williams paper popularized training multi-layer neural networks by propagating error gradients backwards through the network.
name: Backpropagation
source_title: Learning representations by back-propagating errors - Nature

causal_claim: Linnainmaa's automatic differentiation made the modern AI agent possible by originating reverse-mode differentiation, the exact gradient computation that backpropagation and all modern deep learning frameworks perform.
definition: Seppo Linnainmaa's 1970 master's thesis gave the first efficient representation of the derivative of a nested function, the reverse mode of automatic differentiation.
name: Linnainmaa's automatic differentiation
source_title: The representation of the cumulative rounding error of an algorithm as a Taylor expansion of the local rounding errors

causal_claim: Distributional hypothesis made the modern AI agent possible by supplying the linguistic principle that meaning can be learned from context statistics, the foundation of word embeddings and LLM training.
definition: Zellig Harris's distributional hypothesis holds that words occurring in similar contexts have similar meanings, grounding semantics in co-occurrence statistics.
name: Distributional hypothesis
source_title: Distributional Structure - Word

causal_claim: Word2vec made the modern AI agent possible by proving words could be embedded as dense vectors learned from raw text at scale, the representation scheme transformers inherit and generalize.
definition: Mikolov and colleagues' word2vec learns dense vector embeddings of words from large corpora so that semantic relations become vector arithmetic.
name: Word2vec
source_title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space - arXiv

causal_claim: Energy-based model (Hopfield network / Boltzmann machine) made the modern AI agent possible by importing physics energy-minimization into learning, a lineage that leads to modern probabilistic and attention-like associative memory models.
definition: Hopfield networks and Boltzmann machines imported statistical-physics energy functions into neural computation, treating network states as energy minima.
name: Energy-based model (Hopfield network / Boltzmann machine)
source_title: Boltzmann machine - Wikipedia

causal_claim: Simulated annealing made the modern AI agent possible by showing physical processes could be turned into optimization algorithms, part of the physics-to-learning transfer that shaped stochastic training methods.
definition: Kirkpatrick, Gelatt and Vecchi adapted the metallurgical annealing process, via the Metropolis algorithm, into a general method for combinatorial optimization.
name: Simulated annealing
source_title: Optimization by simulated annealing - Science

causal_claim: Bayesian network made the modern AI agent possible by formalizing probabilistic reasoning over structured variables, the statistics-derived framework for decision-making under uncertainty that agent planning builds on.
definition: Judea Pearl's Bayesian networks represent probabilistic dependencies as directed graphs, enabling principled reasoning under uncertainty.
name: Bayesian network
source_title: Fusion, propagation, and structuring in belief networks - ACM Digital Library

causal_claim: Markov decision process made the modern AI agent possible by giving the mathematical definition of an agent acting over time, the object every reinforcement-learning-trained agent policy optimizes.
definition: Bellman's Markov decision process formalizes sequential decision-making as states, actions, transition probabilities and rewards.
name: Markov decision process
source_title: Markov decision process - Wikipedia

causal_claim: Optimal control theory (dynamic programming) made the modern AI agent possible by supplying the value-function and Bellman-equation machinery that reinforcement learning, and hence RLHF-tuned agents, directly inherit.
definition: Richard Bellman's dynamic programming decomposes sequential decisions into nested subproblems, founding optimal control and value-function methods.
name: Optimal control theory (dynamic programming)
source_title: Dynamic Programming - Princeton University Press

causal_claim: AlphaGo made the modern AI agent possible by demonstrating that learned models plus search could plan and act superhumanly in a complex environment, the template for agentic reasoning-and-acting systems.
definition: DeepMind's AlphaGo combined deep policy and value networks with Monte Carlo tree search to defeat a top human Go professional.
name: AlphaGo
source_title: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search - Nature

causal_claim: Dropout made the modern AI agent possible by making very large networks trainable without catastrophic overfitting, a precondition for scaling to LLM size.
definition: Dropout randomly disables units during training, preventing co-adaptation and dramatically improving generalization of large neural networks.
name: Dropout
source_title: Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting - JMLR

causal_claim: Adam optimizer made the modern AI agent possible by making stochastic gradient training of huge networks stable and practical, the optimizer used to train nearly every production LLM.
definition: Adam is an adaptive stochastic optimization algorithm combining momentum and per-parameter learning rates, published by Kingma and Ba.
name: Adam optimizer
source_title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization - arXiv

causal_claim: Byte-pair encoding tokenization made the modern AI agent possible by giving LLMs a robust way to convert arbitrary text into model tokens, the input layer every agent's reasoning depends on.
definition: Sennrich, Haddow and Birch adapted byte-pair encoding to subword segmentation so neural models can handle open vocabularies with a fixed token set.
name: Byte-pair encoding tokenization
source_title: Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units - arXiv

causal_claim: Attention mechanism (Bahdanau) made the modern AI agent possible by introducing learned soft alignment over context, the mechanism transformers later generalized into self-attention.
definition: Bahdanau, Cho and Bengio introduced additive attention, letting a decoder dynamically focus on relevant source words during translation.
name: Attention mechanism (Bahdanau)
source_title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate - arXiv

causal_claim: Sequence-to-sequence learning made the modern AI agent possible by establishing the encoder-decoder paradigm of mapping arbitrary text in to arbitrary text out, the shape of every LLM interaction.
definition: Sutskever, Vinyals and Le showed an LSTM encoder-decoder could map input sequences to output sequences end-to-end for machine translation.
name: Sequence-to-sequence learning
source_title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks - arXiv

causal_claim: Transformer architecture made the modern AI agent possible by providing the scalable, parallelizable architecture on which every frontier LLM, and thus every LLM agent, is built.
definition: The Transformer dispenses with recurrence entirely, building sequence models from self-attention, and became the architecture of all modern LLMs.
name: Transformer architecture
source_title: Attention Is All You Need - arXiv

causal_claim: Generative pre-training (GPT-1) made the modern AI agent possible by establishing the pretrain-then-adapt recipe that produces general-purpose language models from raw text.
definition: OpenAI's GPT-1 showed unsupervised generative pre-training of a transformer followed by fine-tuning transfers across language tasks.
name: Generative pre-training (GPT-1)
source_title: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training - OpenAI

causal_claim: BERT made the modern AI agent possible by demonstrating that self-supervised pretraining yields transferable language understanding, validating the foundation-model approach agents rely on.
definition: BERT pretrains deep bidirectional transformer representations with masked language modeling and next-sentence prediction.
name: BERT
source_title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding - arXiv

causal_claim: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) made the modern AI agent possible by converting raw text predictors into instruction-following systems that can be directed, corrected and safely looped by a user.
definition: InstructGPT applied RLHF, training a reward model from human comparisons and optimizing the language model against it with PPO, to make GPT-3 follow instructions.
name: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF)
source_title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback - arXiv

causal_claim: Instruction tuning (FLAN) made the modern AI agent possible by teaching models to treat natural-language instructions as their control interface, the channel through which users and agent scaffolds direct them.
definition: FLAN showed that fine-tuning a language model on a mixture of tasks phrased as natural-language instructions yields strong zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks.
name: Instruction tuning (FLAN)
source_title: Finetuned Language Models Are Zero-Shot Learners - arXiv

causal_claim: Chain-of-thought prompting made the modern AI agent possible by revealing that LLMs can externalize step-by-step reasoning in text, the working-memory mechanism agent loops exploit for planning.
definition: Wei and colleagues showed that prompting large language models to emit intermediate reasoning steps greatly improves multi-step problem solving.
name: Chain-of-thought prompting
source_title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models - arXiv

causal_claim: ReAct agent pattern made the modern AI agent possible by defining the reason-act-observe loop that is the literal architecture of today's LLM agents.
definition: ReAct interleaves language-model reasoning traces with actions and observations, so the model can plan, call tools, and revise based on feedback.
name: ReAct agent pattern
source_title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models - arXiv

causal_claim: ELIZA made the modern AI agent possible by demonstrating that humans will interact with machines conversationally through natural language, the interaction premise of every chat-based agent.
definition: Joseph Weizenbaum's ELIZA simulated a psychotherapist with pattern-matching rules, the first widely known conversational program.
name: ELIZA
source_title: ELIZA - Wikipedia

causal_claim: Shakey the Robot made the modern AI agent possible by first closing the perceive-plan-act loop in one system, the functional architecture modern agents reimplement in software.
definition: SRI's Shakey was the first mobile robot to perceive its environment, build a model of it, plan, and execute actions to achieve goals.
name: Shakey the Robot
source_title: Shakey the Robot - CHM Revolution Exhibit

causal_claim: Lisp programming language made the modern AI agent possible by creating the symbolic-programming substrate in which the first agent-like reasoning systems were built and prototyped.
definition: John McCarthy's Lisp introduced symbolic list processing, recursion and garbage collection as the native medium of early AI research.
name: Lisp programming language
source_title: Recursive Functions of Symbolic Expressions and Their Computation by Machine, Part I - ACM

causal_claim: Logic Theorist made the modern AI agent possible by demonstrating that a machine could carry out heuristic search over symbolic goals, the first concrete instance of automated reasoning.
definition: Newell, Shaw and Simon's Logic Theorist was the first program designed to mimic human problem-solving, proving theorems from Principia Mathematica.
name: Logic Theorist
source_title: The Logic Theory Machine - Newell & Simon (1956)

causal_claim: Dartmouth Workshop made the modern AI agent possible by founding artificial intelligence as an organized research field whose research programs produced every later agent technology.
definition: The 1956 Dartmouth summer workshop coined 'artificial intelligence' and convened the field's founders around the conjecture that intelligence can be simulated by machines.
name: Dartmouth Workshop
source_title: A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence

causal_claim: Expert systems (DENDRAL/MYCIN) made the modern AI agent possible by proving machines could be deployed as task-performing knowledge agents, the commercial ancestor of today's task agents.
definition: DENDRAL and later MYCIN encoded expert knowledge as rule bases that could reason about chemistry and medical diagnosis at expert level in narrow domains.
name: Expert systems (DENDRAL/MYCIN)
source_title: Expert system - Wikipedia

causal_claim: Prolog made the modern AI agent possible by showing declarative goal-directed inference could be mechanized, a direct ancestor of the goal-and-plan machinery in agent architectures.
definition: Prolog is a logic programming language built on Horn clauses, where programs state facts and rules and the interpreter performs automated inference.
name: Prolog
source_title: The Birth of Prolog - Colmerauer & Roussel

causal_claim: Turing Test proposal made the modern AI agent possible by framing machine intelligence as conversational behavior, the criterion chat-based agents are still implicitly judged against.
definition: Alan Turing's 1950 paper proposed the imitation game as an operational test of machine intelligence and anticipated learning machines.
name: Turing Test proposal
source_title: Computing Machinery and Intelligence - Mind

causal_claim: McCulloch-Pitts neuron made the modern AI agent possible by supplying the first formal unit of neural computation from which all network models of learning descend.
definition: McCulloch and Pitts modeled neurons as threshold logic units, the first mathematical model of an artificial neural network.
name: McCulloch-Pitts neuron
source_title: A logical calculus of the ideas immanent in nervous activity - Bulletin of Mathematical Biophysics

causal_claim: General Problem Solver made the modern AI agent possible by introducing means-ends analysis, the goal-directed planning schema that agent architectures still instantiate.
definition: Newell, Shaw and Simon's General Problem Solver attacked problems by means-ends analysis, reducing differences between current and goal states.
name: General Problem Solver
source_title: Report on a general problem-solving program - ACM Digital Library

causal_claim: Deep Blue made the modern AI agent possible by proving a machine could out-perform the best human at a flagship intellectual task through search, legitimizing machine agency in adversarial domains.
definition: IBM's Deep Blue defeated world champion Garry Kasparov using massively parallel alpha-beta search and hand-tuned evaluation.
name: Deep Blue
source_title: Deep Blue - IBM Research

causal_claim: TD-Gammon made the modern AI agent possible by first proving an agent can reach expert performance by learning from its own experience, the self-improvement loop at the heart of RL-trained agents.
definition: Tesauro's TD-Gammon learned world-class backgammon play purely by self-play temporal-difference reinforcement learning.
name: TD-Gammon
source_title: Practical Issues in Temporal Difference Learning - Springer

causal_claim: Speech recognition (Dragon NaturallySpeaking) made the modern AI agent possible by opening the voice channel through which users now direct agents hands-free.
definition: Dragon NaturallySpeaking was the first general-purpose continuous speech recognition product for dictation on personal computers.
name: Speech recognition (Dragon NaturallySpeaking)
source_title: Dragon NaturallySpeaking - Wikipedia

causal_claim: Siri made the modern AI agent possible by normalizing the consumer expectation of a conversational assistant that takes actions on your behalf, the market category LLM agents now fulfill.
definition: Apple's Siri brought a voice-controlled personal assistant that interprets natural language and delegates to services to a mass consumer device.
name: Siri
source_title: Siri - Wikipedia

causal_claim: Watson (Jeopardy!) made the modern AI agent possible by demonstrating machine question-answering over open-domain natural language at champion level, a direct functional precursor of knowledge agents.
definition: IBM Watson defeated Jeopardy! champions by combining massive evidence retrieval with probabilistic answer scoring over unstructured text.
name: Watson (Jeopardy!)
source_title: This is Watson - IBM Journal of Research and Development
